Turn grain into bread to improve food variety.
Recruit hunters that hunt land creatures for their carcasses. Obtain a greatsword, useful for fighting multiple foes at once.
Turn coin into entertainment to improve happiness.
Turn grain into drink to improve happiness.
Turn carcasses into sausages to improve food variety. Mark undiscovered land-based creature nests on the map.
Turn cloth into fashion to increase happiness.
Gather ashes, rot, seaweed, kelp, and manure as organic waste to make fertilizer, for use in farming and to make gunpowder.
Produce bricks to build roads, walls, staircases, bridges, and other infrastructure.
Build fences to keep tamed woolies in one place.
Turn coin into entertainment to improve morale.
Terraform the environment with the shovel at the cost of landfill. Gain landfill by lowering terrain, spend it by raising it.
Build mortar towers that bombard land targets from afar with indirect fire, but require gunpowder as upkeep.
Grow vegetables that are ready to harvest the next day (except in winter), but require fertilizer as upkeep.
Build wells for extinguishing burning characters (buildings are extinguished by repairing them with the wrench). Obtain a lantern, useful for setting fire to camps and nests.
Turn raw fish into fried fish to improve food variety. Obtain a spear, useful for fighting in water.
Build airships that fights enemies from above, but require mana as upkeep.
Turn vegetables into stew to improve food variety.
Build walls, staircases, bridges, and other infrastructure. Obtain a greathammer, useful for destroying boulders and enemy camps.
Unlock the necessary basics to keep your citizens alive in the long run.
Build air defense cannons that fires directly at incoming targets including airships, but require gunpowder as upkeep.
Turn fertilizer and sulfur into gunpowder. Build single-use powder kegs which can be thrown to explode near enemies.
Gather herbs in forests and highlands for use as medicine.
Find monster eggs from wild nests and use them to raise woolies, which provide fiber to turn into fashion.
Burn enemy settlements with fire bombs.
Turn logs into fuel, use them together with ore to make components for military structures and vehicles.
Grow wheat that is ready to harvest the next day (except in winter), but require fertilizer as upkeep. Turn wheat into grain.
Place mines on deposits to generate ore, which can be used to build roads and to terraform terrain with the shovel.
Recruit musketeers who shoot enemies from afar with powerful muskets, but are vulnerable while reloading.
Grow apple trees that bear fruit every day in summer, but require fertilizer as upkeep. Make sure to leave enough space for each tree to grow.
Turn fuel into mana with atmospheric collectors placed at high altitude to power airships.
Build apothecaries that heal friendly characters from any distance, but require medicine as upkeep.
Recruit tough, armored halberdiers who fight enemies in melee. Obtain a shield, useful to block incoming attacks.
Build mines on deposits for ore, but don’t build too many in a single area to avoid polluting the zone. Mark ore veins on the map.
Recruit builders who repair and rebuild nearby structures.
Destroy outlaw structures for scrap used to speed up research, or to refine into components. Mark undiscovered outlaw camps on the map.
Gather fiber from coastal cattails or by shearing fluffy woolies, to make cloth.
Build fishing boats that hunt aquatic creatures, but require fuel as upkeep.
Turn carcasses and fuel into soap to increase happiness.
Turn rocks into bricks for building roads. Obtain a shovel, useful for altering the terrain.
Gather volcanic plants that grow on rock tiles for sulfur to use in gunpowder.
Tame wild woolies and house them in woolie barns. Woolies harvest and consume forage (bushes, ferns, tall grass, sunflowers, seagrass).
Passively collect coins from all employed civilians.

Overthrown is in a pre-release state as it needs a bit more time to cook before it's fully complete.

The game might crash, some features may not work correctly, and there is still much more to add to the game before we release into 1.0. Your feedback will help us create this game together.

You can drop any ideas, feedback, or issues you may have on our Discord server where we are very active! For support queries, you may also reach us at support@brimstone.games.

Thank you for your understanding and thank you to the community for all the support you've given to us during our development!
